description: Securities & Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka - The Unit Trust Code for Sri Lanka Real Estate Investment Trusts, No. 1 of 2020
categorisation: This gazette contains rules and regulations made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka under the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 36 of 1987. It establishes a regulatory framework for Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), including definitions, requirements, and compliance standards. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it creates subsidiary legislation and regulatory requirements rather than dealing with government personnel, organizational changes, or the other specialized categories.
